name: Steve AI
tagline: Steve AI converts blog posts, scripts, and text content into animated or live-action videos automatically. It matches keywords from the script with relevant stock footage, adds automated voiceovers, and produces finished videos in minutes. It is popular for explainer videos, training content, and social media posts.
